note: staleAfterDays is a stall threshold (days a prospect can sit in that stage before the board flags it), based on general sales-pipeline norms (mid-stage deals with no activity for 20+ days are commonly treated as stalled). It only fires when stageEnteredDate is actually logged on a prospect, never guessed. Every stage color below is checked against this app's actual panel backgrounds (#08090A/#101215/#16181C) for the WCAG 1.4.11 3:1 non-text contrast minimum, since these render as small dots the board relies on to convey stage at a glance. entryCriteria is a real, checkable sales-pipeline pattern (every stage has exit/entry criteria, not just a color and a description): each id names a structural field this board already tracks, checked live by CSMCore.stageEntryCriteriaStatus against a real prospect before a move into that stage is treated as ready, never a made-up gate.
